questions.question: What is the main function of a battery pack in an electric vehicle?

answers.a: To store and supply electrical energy

explanations.a: Correct. The battery pack stores electrical energy and supplies power to the electric motor.
explanations.b: Vehicle speed is controlled by the motor and controller, not the battery pack.
explanations.c: Motor cooling is handled by a separate cooling system.
explanations.d: The suspension system supports vehicle stability and ride comfort.

questions.question: Which of the following parameters is commonly monitored in an EV battery system?

explanations.a: Correct. Battery temperature is monitored to ensure safe operation.
explanations.b: Tyre tread depth is checked during vehicle maintenance.
explanations.c: Wheel alignment is related to vehicle handling, not battery condition.
explanations.d: Road gradient affects driving performance but is not monitored by the battery system.

questions.question: Why is heat generated inside a battery during charging and discharging?

explanations.a: Correct. Internal resistance causes some electrical energy to be converted into heat.
explanations.b: Road friction does not generate heat inside the battery cells.
explanations.c: Air pressure has very little effect on battery heat generation.
explanations.d: Vehicle weight affects energy consumption but not battery heating directly.

questions.question: The main purpose of a Battery Management System (BMS)?

answers.b: To monitor and protect the battery pack

explanations.a: The BMS does not directly increase vehicle speed.
explanations.b: Correct. The BMS monitors battery voltage, current, and temperature and protects the battery from unsafe conditions.
explanations.c: Steering is controlled by the vehicle steering system.
explanations.d: Road grip depends on tyres and road conditions.

questions.question: What is meant by thermal runaway in a battery?

answers.a: A condition where the battery cools rapidly
answers.b: A condition where heat generation becomes uncontrollable
answers.c: A condition where charging stops automatically
answers.d: A condition where battery voltage becomes zero

explanations.a: Thermal runaway happens because of excessive heating, not cooling.
explanations.b: Correct. The battery starts generating heat faster than it can remove it, causing a rapid rise in temperature.
explanations.c: Charging may stop for safety reasons, but that is not thermal runaway.
explanations.d: A drop in voltage can happen, but it is not the main reason for thermal runaway.

explanations.a: This is not related to thermal runaway propagation.
explanations.b: Correct. Heat from a faulty cell can spread to nearby cells and trigger further failures.
explanations.c: Propagation refers to heat spreading, not cooling.
explanations.d: Voltage balancing is a different battery management process.

questions.question: What can happen if a battery cell reaches a critical temperature?

answers.a: The cell may enter thermal runaway

explanations.a: Correct. Excessive temperature can trigger thermal runaway inside the cell.
explanations.b: Battery capacity does not increase because of temperature rise.
explanations.c: Motor speed is not directly increased by battery temperature.
explanations.d: Temperature and state of charge are different battery parameters.

questions.question: Why is an Emergency Battery Isolation System (EBIS) used in EV battery packs?

answers.b: To disconnect the faulty battery section during unsafe conditions

explanations.a: Battery isolation does not increase capacity.
explanations.b: Correct. EBIS isolates the affected section to reduce damage and prevent fault spread.
explanations.c: Improving charging speed is not the purpose of EBIS.
explanations.d: Isolation has no effect on vehicle weight.

questions.question: Why is fast battery isolation important during a thermal fault?

answers.b: To reduce thermal propagation and battery damage

explanations.a: Motor power is not the focus during a battery fault.
explanations.b: Correct. Faster isolation helps stop the fault from affecting more battery cells.
explanations.c: Suspension performance is unrelated to battery isolation.
explanations.d: Driving range is not the main concern during a thermal emergency.

explanations.a: Electric vehicles do not use conventional fuel.
explanations.b: Correct. The simulation shows how temperature spreads and how many cells are affected.
explanations.c: Vehicle speed is not the focus of this experiment.
explanations.d: Tyre wear is unrelated to thermal runaway analysis.
